.text
.globl abi_probe
.type abi_probe,@function
abi_probe:
    push %rbx
    push %rbp
    push %r12
    push %r13
    push %r14
    push %r15
    sub $8, %rsp
    mov %rdi, %r11
    mov %rsi, %rdi
    mov $0x123456, %ebx
    mov $0x234567, %ebp
    mov $0x345678, %r12d
    mov $0x456789, %r13d
    mov $0x56789a, %r14d
    mov $0x6789ab, %r15d
    call *%r11
    cmp $0x123456, %rbx
    jne 1f
    cmp $0x234567, %rbp
    jne 1f
    cmp $0x345678, %r12
    jne 1f
    cmp $0x456789, %r13
    jne 1f
    cmp $0x56789a, %r14
    jne 1f
    cmp $0x6789ab, %r15
    jne 1f
    xor %eax, %eax
    jmp 2f
1:  mov $1, %eax
2:  add $8, %rsp
    pop %r15
    pop %r14
    pop %r13
    pop %r12
    pop %rbp
    pop %rbx
    ret
.size abi_probe,.-abi_probe
.globl corrupt_callee
.type corrupt_callee,@function
corrupt_callee:
    xor %ebx, %ebx
    ret
.size corrupt_callee,.-corrupt_callee
.globl special_probe
.type special_probe,@function
special_probe:
    sub $8, %rsp
    mov $0x123456, %edi
    mov $0x234567, %esi
    mov $0x345678, %edx
    mov $0x456789, %ecx
    mov $0x56789a, %r8d
    mov $0x6789ab, %r9d
    mov $0x789abc, %r10d
    mov $0x89abcd, %r11d
    call __sw_hweight64
    cmp $0x123456, %rdi
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x234567, %rsi
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x345678, %rdx
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x456789, %rcx
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x56789a, %r8
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x6789ab, %r9
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x789abc, %r10
    jne 3f
    cmp $0x89abcd, %r11
    jne 3f
    xor %eax, %eax
    jmp 4f
3:  mov $1, %eax
4:  add $8, %rsp
    ret
.size special_probe,.-special_probe
.section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
